$comment: Historical stub, superseded. datasets/incident_dataset/schema.json is authoritative for this dataset: datasets/incident_dataset/validate.py validates entries against it. It extends the fields this file used to define with a required title and disclosure ('public' or 'anonymized'), source_urls (required for public entries), affected_organizations (public entries only), precision, crosswalk_id and contributor, and it rejects unknown fields. This file is kept only so a $ref into it does not break; edit the dataset-local schema instead.
